<subject>Re: Vridha Commodities From Harvest Alliance</subject>
<body>
Reyansh Salvi

My understanding is that Hebert doesn't have the legal authority (and the filing never makes clear) to suspend performance under the offtake agreement (he probably doesn't have the political support for this either).

IACC, however, could support this in its filing as a method to help move the farmer cooperative issue forward. We should consider whether contract release mechanisms align with our procurement strategy, particularly given the regulatory environment in Maharashtra. The risk remains that once farmers are released, state-level restrictions could be imposed to keep commodity flows localized. We need to coordinate with legal before responding.

Hardik
</body>
